weakness: No account procedure, approvals, reviews, or monitoring; former MSR's core account enabled 5 months after departure
source: P07 (AC-02 objectives); P01 R-004; P03 G-023
remediation_plan: Onboarding and termination checklist covering the core, admin console, wire portal, LOS, suite, and cloud console (POL-02 B.4); monthly reconciliation (B.5); written criteria for the supervisor override
milestones: 2026-08-05 former MSR account disabled; 2026-09-30 checklist in use; 2026-10-31 first monthly reconciliation

weakness: Operations Manager holds both the wire portal administrator role and an approver token
remediation_plan: Move the portal administrator role to the President and CEO, who holds no approver token; the corporate credit union confirms the change in writing

weakness: MSP cloud console login accepts a password alone and is shared by two technicians
remediation_plan: Named MSP accounts with MFA; separate role for snapshot deletion; MSP sends screenshots

weakness: Member Services mailbox accepted a password-only sign-in; core teller users have no MFA
remediation_plan: Mailbox converted to delegated access through named accounts with MFA (done 2026-08-12); password reset; ask the core processor for teller MFA at contract renewal; keep the office IP allowlist

weakness: No time limit for disabling access; shared password not changed; no exit reminder of confidentiality
remediation_plan: Last-day checklist (same as POAM-001) including shared passwords, wire tokens, and a signed confidentiality reminder

weakness: No training on BEC, changed wire instructions, pretext calls, or social mining
source: P07 interviews; P01 R-001 R-018; P03 G-025 G-033
remediation_plan: Annual security training with BEC and wire fraud content; quarterly phishing exercises; monthly reminder email; reporting card at each workstation
milestones: 2026-09-30 reporting cards; 2026-10-31 first training; 2026-12-31 first phishing exercise

weakness: No review of core reports, admin console log, wire portal activity, or suite sign-ins
remediation_plan: Monthly 45-minute review with a checklist (core override and employee-account reports by the Accounting and Compliance Officer; admin console contact and payee changes, wire activity, and suite sign-ins by the ISO); findings to the President and CEO
resources_required: ISO and Accounting and Compliance Officer time

weakness: Imaging snapshots in the same account and deletable by one login; no backup of suite mailboxes or security documents
remediation_plan: Copy of imaging backups to a separate account with 30-day immutable retention; export security documents monthly to the imaging server backup; decide on a suite backup service
milestones: 2026-10-31 separate copy running; 2026-11-30 suite backup decision

weakness: Continuity plan never tested; no imaging restore; alternate wire never tried
remediation_plan: MSP restores the imaging server to a test copy; alternate phone wire test with the corporate credit union; tabletop of the P08 runbook; quarterly restore tests recorded
milestones: 2026-09-30 first restore test; 2026-10-31 alternate wire test; 2026-11-30 tabletop

weakness: No staff reporting rule; no NCUA 72-hour report or Regional Director notice step
remediation_plan: POL-03 4.2 and 4.4 in training and on workstation cards; NCUA contact details and report template in the P08 binder

weakness: 2019 plan outdated: no wire fraud, member notice, SAR, vendor, or NCUA content; not distributed
remediation_plan: POL-03 and the P08 runbook replace the 2019 plan (approved 2026-08-25 and 2026-08-31); printed binders; copies to the MSP and the insurer's contact

weakness: Risk assessment not reviewed or updated from 2019 to 2026; not yet shared with the board at fieldwork
remediation_plan: Annual update each July under POL-02 A.2; summary in each August board report
milestones: 2026-08-25 first board presentation; 2027-07-31 first annual update

weakness: No security requirements or incident notice terms in vendor contracts; SOC reports unread; no MSP evidence
remediation_plan: Core side letter on incident notice; MSP amendment (notice, recovery commitment, tenant ownership, technician list, MFA evidence); annual SOC reviews with CUEC mapping
milestones: 2026-08-18 core SOC review done; 2026-10-31 core side letter; 2026-11-30 digital banking provider SOC review; 2026-12-31 MSP amendment
